why: Two builds of identical input are compared for equality. A host executable that embeds an address or a path is not byte-identical even when it is semantically identical, so the contract allows normalising such fields provided every removed field is listed here in advance. Nothing that carries semantic configuration, a numeric result or a cycle count may be removed, and nothing may be added to this list to make a failing comparison pass.

removed.reason: Icarus names its scope and parameter symbols after the address of the object that created them, so ASLR changes them on every run. The symbol's *name* carries no semantics; its content -- the scope path, the parameter value, the timescale -- is on the same line and is not touched.
The interpreter path differs between environment A and environment B by construction. It is not part of what was compiled.
Absolute paths to the installed VPI modules, for the same reason.

never_removed: any numeric literal that is not an address
